HibModelINLA

Source: R/class_inla_mod.R
HibModelINLA-Class.Rd

This is the template object for an R6 INLA model class. It contains functions for summarising and visualising the model results.

Details

Template object for INLA model

Public fields

dataset_name

(character)
Identifies the dataset used.

last_update

(character)
Identifies the most recent update to the object (YYYY-MM-DD).

data

(data.frame)
The data used in model fitting.

model

(inla)
The INLA::inla model object.

processing_flags

(list())
Identifies the processing steps used for the HibDatabase object that was used for model fitting.

fixedef_coefficients

(data.frame)
The fixed effects coefficients.

user_formula

(formula or list)
The model formula supplied by the user (includes the fixed effects and non-spatial random effects).

inla_fitted_formula

(formula)
The fitted model formula (includes all effects).

inla_incl_spatial_term

(logical)
TRUE or FALSE, does the model include a spatial term.

inla_stack

(inla.data.stack)
The data.stack used in model fitting, an INLA object.

inla_mesh

(inla.mesh or NULL)
If used, the mesh used in model fitting.

inla_mesh_settings

(list)
A list of specifications for generating the mesh, if used in modelling.

inla_mesh_source

(character or NULL)
A description of the mesh source - if not null, can be either "user_provided" or "mesh_settings".

site_locations

(data.frame)
Contains columns for "SSBS", "Longitude" ,"Latitude".

HibModelINLA$new()

Creates a new instance of this R6 class. Note, this object is constructed via the hib_fit_inla function found within this package.

Usage

HibModelINLA$new(
  db_obj,
  mod_df,
  inla_obj,
  fixef_df,
  user_formula,
  inla_fitted_formula,
  inla_incl_spatial_term,
  inla_stack,
  inla_mesh,
  inla_mesh_settings,
  inla_mesh_source,
  n_spp,
  n_taxa,
  n_sites
)

Arguments

db_obj

(HibDatabase, or list)
The HibDatabase object/s used to fit the model.

mod_df

(data.frame)
The data.frame of the data used in model fitting.

inla_obj

(inla)
The inla model object.

fixef_df

(data.frame)
The fixed effects from the fitted model.

user_formula

(formula or list)
The model formula supplied by the user.

inla_fitted_formula

(formula)
The fitted model formula.

inla_incl_spatial_term

(logical)
TRUE or FALSE, does the model include a spatial term.

inla_stack

(inla.data.stack)
The data.stack used in model fitting, an INLA object.

inla_mesh

(inla.mesh or NULL)
If used, the mesh used in model fitting.

inla_mesh_settings

(list)
A list of specifications for generating the mesh.

inla_mesh_source

(character or NULL)
A description of the mesh source.

n_spp

(integer)
Number of species contributing to the fitted model.

n_taxa

(integer)
Number of orignal taxa names contributing to the fitted model.

n_sites

(integer)
Number of sites contributing to the fitted model.

@return (HibModelINLA)

metr_ls

(list)
The list of model performance metrics.

HibModelINLA$plot()

Function to generate figures summarising the model.

Usage

HibModelINLA$plot(type = "fixed-effects")

Arguments

type

(character()) Options are: "fixed-effects", "random-effects", "spatial-random-field", "map-sites".

Returns

(ggplot).
